title: NICE: Scale-Stable Perturbations for Graph Neural Network Explanations via Noise Corruption
abstract: arXiv:2608.16038v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Post-hoc Graph Neural Network (GNN) explainers commonly follow a Perturb-Query paradigm, inferring the importance of graph elements based on queried predictions to perturbed inputs. However, such perturbations often introduce substantial distribution shift, undermining the reliability of the queried predictions used to derive explanations. While existing efforts mainly improve perturbed graphs or stabilize model predictions on them, we revisit the perturbation mechanism itself. We show that the widely used Element-wise Masking(EM) suppresses edge-induced messages toward zero, causing deterministic scale contraction that accumulates across message-passing layers, a phenomenon we term Scale Drift. Consequently, prediction changes under EM may conflate information corruption with deviations in propagation scale. As a scale-stable alternative to EM, we introduce Noise Corruption (NC), which perturbs each message through matched-norm random

translated_title: NICE：通过噪声破坏实现图神经网络解释的尺度稳定扰动
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16038v1 公告类型：交叉  摘要：事后图神经网络（GNN）解释器通常遵循“扰动-查询”范式，基于对扰动输入的查询预测来推断图元素的重要性。然而，这种扰动往往会引入显著的分布偏移，削弱用于生成解释的查询预测的可靠性。虽然现有工作主要致力于改进扰动图或稳定模型对其的预测，我们重新审视了扰动机制本身。我们表明，广泛使用的元素级掩蔽（EM）将边诱导消息抑制为零，导致确定性尺度收缩，并在消息传递层间累积，我们将这一现象称为“尺度漂移”。因此，在EM下的预测变化可能将信息破坏与传播尺度的偏差混为一谈。作为EM的尺度稳定替代方案，我们引入了噪声破坏（NC），通过匹配范数的随机扰动来扰动每条消息。
tldr: 本文提出噪声破坏（NC）替代元素级掩蔽（EM）作为图神经网络解释中的扰动机制，解决了EM导致的尺度漂移问题，从而提高了解释的可靠性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Noise Corruption (NC) as a scale-stable alternative to Element-wise Masking (EM) in GNN explanation perturbations, addressing the scale drift issue and enhancing explanation reliability.
